jobs.title: Director of Communications (m/f/d) - Maternity Cover - Fixed Term Contract
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AND CULTURE

We are driven to create a future where people and place enrich one another. We are wholly committed to rooting ourselves more deeply in every place we are in while setting new benchmarks for positive impact. As a pioneering collective with a common purpose, we curate extraordinary moments and honor the soul of every place along our journey. At Rosewood Hotel Group, we answer The Calling. Together, we Make the Place.

YOUR ROLE

The Director of Communications plays a pivotal role in shaping and executing the hotel’s integrated marketing, public relations, and communications strategy. This position ensures brand consistency, elevates the property’s image in the luxury lifestyle sector, and drives engagement through innovative campaigns. By leading strategic initiatives across media relations, digital marketing, partnerships, and content creation, this role directly impacts revenue growth, guest loyalty, and market positioning. You will report directly to the Managing Director, collaborating closely with corporate brand teams, operations, and external partners.

HOW YOU'LL MAKE THE PLACE

Develop and implement a comprehensive marketing, communications, and public relations strategy aligned with Rosewood’s vision and brand standards.
Oversee all hotel marketing activities and digital eco system, including publications, media relations, property programming, partnerships, retail, events, digital marketing, website content strategy, UX-driven storytelling, SEO performance CRM, eCommerce, social media, and content creation.
Establish, monitor and track core communications KPIs, including Earned Media Value, Share of Voice, sentiment analysis and engagement metrics
Act as the hotel’s primary representative for media, influencers, and KOLs; host press events, interviews, and trips to drive coverage and build relationships.
Manage editorial direction, storytelling, and profiling of key spokespersons; oversee production and distribution of all publications.
Lead agency management for PR, marketing, and social media, including RFP processes, onboarding, and performance evaluation.
Identify and secure strategic partnerships in lifestyle, fashion, and retail sectors to enhance brand positioning.
Ensure all print and digital materials adhere to brand guidelines and maintain visual consistency.
Oversee social media strategy, content production, and performance reporting across all channels.
Support Talent & Culture initiatives by promoting the hotel’s philosophy internally and managing LinkedIn strategy.
Lead crisis communications planning and execution.
Present monthly, quarterly, and annual plans and results to key stakeholders, including corporate brand teams and property leadership.
Monitor market trends and conduct research to inform strategy and maintain competitive positioning.
Manage annual communications budget, ensuring ROI-driven decisions and alignment with corporate guidelines.
Foster a high-performance team culture through coaching, mentoring, and succession planning.

 COULD THIS BE YOU?

Shape and elevate the hotel’s luxury brand narrative, crafting compelling storytelling and positioning that resonates with a global audience and reflects the essence of Rosewood.
Lead and execute high-end PR strategies, building and maintaining strong relationships with international media to ensure consistent brand visibility and reputation.
Develop and activate exclusive luxury lifestyle partnerships and collaborations that enhance brand awareness and create distinctive, high-impact moments.
Drive and oversee an integrated social media strategy (organic and paid), strengthening engagement, reach, and brand equity across all key platforms.
Lead the hotel’s digital marketing efforts, including SEO, content, and performance-driven campaigns, ensuring measurable business impact and relevance in the luxury market.
Curate and refine the hotel’s digital storytelling through website content strategies and UX-driven journeys that deliver a seamless and inspiring guest experience.
Monitor and analyze key communications KPIs such as EMV, Share of Voice, engagement, and sentiment, translating insights into strategic actions and continuous optimization.
Oversee and guide agency partnerships across PR, social, creative, and digital, ensuring alignment with brand standards and best-in-class execution.
Build strong relationships with key internal stakeholders, working closely with Managing Director, Corporate teams, Sales, and Revenue to ensure integrated and aligned strategies.
Stay ahead of market trends and competitive positioning, proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen the hotel’s presence within the luxury landscape.
Lead, inspire, and develop a high-performing communications team, fostering a culture of creativity, accountability, and excellence.
Manage communications budgets with a clear focus on ROI, ensuring effective allocation of resources and measurable outcomes.
Navigate crisis communications with confidence and composure, protecting and strengthening the hotel’s reputation in all situations.
Communicate with clarity, confidence, and impact, demonstrating excellent written and verbal skills in both English and German.

jobs.title: Reputation & Crisis Communications Manager (Entertainment)
jobs.description:
I. JOB DESCRIPTION:

Content Hub is the entertainment production arm of DatVietVAC Group Holdings, home to many of Vietnam's leading television shows, reality programs, live entertainment events, and original content. We are looking for a PR & Risk Manager
(Reputation & Crisis Communications Manager) to protect and strengthen the reputation of our productions, artists, and brands through strategic communications, media relations, public sentiment management, and crisis response.
1. Reputation & Crisis Management (35%)

Monitor media coverage, social conversations, and public sentiment through social listening tools.
Identify potential reputation risks and activate crisis response processes when necessary.
Assess incidents, recommend communication strategies, and coordinate cross-functional response plans.
Prepare holding statements, key messages, Q&A documents, and official communication materials.
Serve as the primary communications contact with media for approved issues and crisis situations.
Escalate critical reputation risks to senior management and provide timely updates throughout incident handling.

2. Public Sentiment & Communications Strategy (30%)

Develop communication strategies to strengthen brand reputation and support major entertainment projects.
Plan and execute public relations initiatives across press, social media, and digital platforms.
Build communication plans that proactively shape public perception and manage sensitive discussions.
Ensure all communication activities align with corporate messaging, legal requirements, and brand guidelines.
Support strategic communications for high-profile productions, artists, and entertainment campaigns.

3. Media Relations & Stakeholder Engagement (20%)

Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, media partners, KOLs, and industry stakeholders.
Organize press conferences, media briefings, premieres, launch events, and other PR activities.
Coordinate media interviews, press releases, and official announcements for productions and corporate initiatives.
Support communication activities involving artists, production teams, partners, and external stakeholders.

4. Reporting & Process Improvement (10%)

Prepare regular reports on media performance, brand reputation, public sentiment, and communication effectiveness.
Conduct post-incident reviews and recommend improvements to crisis communication processes.
Maintain crisis communication playbooks, media contact databases, and response guidelines.

5. Other Responsibilities (5%)

Perform other duties and projects assigned by the direct supervisor.

II. JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.
At least 6 years of experience
in Public Relations, Corporate Communications, Reputation Management, or Crisis Communications.
Minimum 3 years of experience in a managerial or leadership role
.
Hands-on experience handling media relations and communication strategies during high-profile or sensitive situations.
Previous experience in the entertainment, media, television, content production, or consumer-facing industries is highly preferred.
Strong understanding of crisis communication frameworks, reputation management, and stakeholder communications.
Experience using social listening and media monitoring tools to identify communication risks and emerging issues.
Familiarity with media law, advertising regulations, and communications best practices is an advantage.
Ability to leverage AI tools to support media monitoring, sentiment analysis, communication planning, and drafting communication materials while ensuring all official communications are reviewed and approved by authorized stakeholders.
Excellent writing, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong analytical thinking, sound judgment, and the ability to make decisions under pressure.
Calm, resilient, highly organized, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Proficient in Microsoft Office and communication reporting tools.
Good command of English in both written and spoken communication.

jobs.title: Executive / Senior Executive, Strategic Communications
jobs.description:
About WWF-Singapore

WWF-Singapore is part of the global WWF network, one of the world's largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. Our mission is to stop the degradation of the planet's natural environment and to build a future in which humans live in harmony with nature.
As Singapore strengthens its leadership in sustainability, WWF-Singapore plays an important role in advancing awareness, engagement and action on climate, nature and environmental issues through impactful communications and partnerships.

Overview

The Executive / Senior Executive, Strategic Communications supports the development and delivery of WWF-Singapore's integrated communications initiatives across digital, media and stakeholder engagement channels.

The role combines communications, media relations, content creation and visual storytelling to help translate complex sustainability topics into clear, engaging and impactful science-based content. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator with good design instincts, an eye for detail, an understanding of user experience principles, and a positive, proactive attitude.

Key Responsibilities

1. Communications & Media Relations

Develop and adapt content across digital, social media, website, publications and stakeholder communications channels.
Support communications campaigns, thought leadership initiatives and media engagement through the development of key messages, media materials and content assets.
Translate sustainability and conservation topics into clear, engaging and audience-centric communications while ensuring consistency with WWF's brand and messaging.
Develop a strong understanding of WWF-Singapore’s key competencies and advocacy positions on sustainability, climate change, conservation and related topics locally and internationally

2. Design & Digital Communications

Drive end-to-end content delivery across websites, digital platforms and exhibitions, coordinating with developers and vendors to ensure timely and effective implementation.
Curate and manage content across digital platforms, websites and exhibitions, and coordinate with developers, designers and external vendors to ensure accurate, engaging and timely implementation of content assets and visitor-facing experiences.
Apply design and UI/UX principles to strengthen visual storytelling, audience engagement and digital user experiences, including website content.
Stay abreast of emerging trends and best practices in communications, design and digital engagement.

3. Stakeholder Engagement & Project Coordination

Collaborate with internal teams, agencies and external partners to deliver integrated communications initiatives and organisational priorities.
Support events, media opportunities and stakeholder engagements, while coordinating vendors and communications-related projects.
Monitor communications performance, track engagement metrics and support reporting on outcomes and impact.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Multimedia, Design or a related field.
2 to 5 years of relevant experience in communications, public relations, media relations, content development or digital marketing.
Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to tailor content for different audiences and platforms.
Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Canva, with experience creating professional visual communications materials.
Familiarity with website content management, digital publishing platforms, social media channels and data analysis tools.
Experience in sustainability, environmental or purpose-driven sectors is an advantage.

Preferred Attributes

Strong visual communication skills with a good eye for design, branding and user experience.
Creative, adaptable and passionate about storytelling, with a positive, proactive and solutions-oriented mindset.
Strong organisational, interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Detail-oriented team player who is eager to learn, take initiative and contribute to WWF's mission and sustainability agenda.

This job description covers the main tasks and conveys the spirit of the sort of responsibilities that are anticipated proactively from staff. Other duties may be assigned as necessary according to organisational needs.

jobs.title: Capital One Insights Center Communications Lead, Public Affairs Manager
Capital One Insights Center Communications Lead, Public Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
At Capital One, we’re building a leading technology company. Founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One helps our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking. We measure our efforts by the success our customers enjoy and the advocacy they exhibit. We are succeeding because they are succeeding.

Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. We elevate each other and obsess about doing the right thing. Our associates serve with humility and a deep respect for their responsibility in helping our customers achieve their goals and realize their dreams. Together, we are on a quest to change banking for good.

Working for one of the world’s most recognized brands that is ranked #106 on the Fortune 500 and #15 on Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For, Capital One provides multiple opportunities to learn and grow while engaging with world-class business leaders across the enterprise.

About the Role:

Capital One is looking for a strategic, creative and results-oriented communications professional to join our Public Affairs team within the Global Policy Affairs Group (GPAG.) Public Affairs is a cross-functional organization within Capital One’s Global Enterprise Affairs (GEA) team that leverages best practices across integrated marketing, strategic communications, stakeholder engagement, research and data intelligence, reputation management and issues advocacy to enable business growth and mitigate risk.

This is a high visibility role that will have direct and regular engagement with senior leaders both inside the company and within key partner organizations. This role provides the opportunity to drive high-visibility, multi-channel strategic communications strategies that tell the story of Capital One to decisionmaker audiences. It is also focused on engaging critical stakeholders and contributing to the national conversation around key economic and societal issues including credit access, affordable housing and entrepreneurship and business creation.

As a key member of the Public Affairs team, you will lead the development of comprehensive, multi-channel campaigns that educate, influence and tell the story of Capital One while advancing enterprise priorities. This role is designed for an experienced professional who can proactively identify emerging trends in the policy environment and macroeconomic landscape and translate complex issues into compelling, data-driven narratives. You will serve as a strategic advisor to internal business leaders and external stakeholders, including industry trade associations, nonprofit partners, think tanks, and policy and civic influencers. You will support the execution of a wide range of external events and convenings, earned media, influencer and digital advertising strategies – ensuring that our public affairs objectives are integrated into the broader corporate reputation and brand narrative.

This position requires exceptional judgment, creative problem solving, attention to detail, focus on results, and an innate ability to influence. A knack for distilling complex issues into compelling stories and a curiosity about perspectives different from your own are essential to the success of this role. Humility, adaptability and a sense of humor will also serve you well.

Primary Responsibilities:

Advocacy and Campaign Execution: Lead the end-to-end strategy and execution of integrated public affairs and data-driven campaigns (earned, paid, owned and digital) to advance policy, legislative and corporate reputation priorities at the federal, state and local levels.
Stakeholder and Third Party Management: Build and leverage trusted relationships with external stakeholders, including policy influencers, trade associations, think tanks, and non-profits to drive joint initiatives.
Media Relations: Cultivate deep relationships with beltway, national, regional and trade media outlets; pitch and secure targeted earned media moments to advance core enterprise narratives.
Executive and Strategic Counsel: Provide real-time, actionable strategic advice to senior business leaders and internal partners, ensuring communications seamlessly line up with enterprise objectives.
Messaging and Content Creation: Draft high-impact strategic materials, executive talking points, communications briefs, and positioning papers on complex issues.
Convenings and Events: Design, manage and execute high-impact thought leadership events, policymaker education programs and strategic convenings both inside and outside the beltway.
Data-Driven Narrative Development: Capitalize on proprietary research and data-driven insights to inform policymaker education, elevate executive profiles and shape public opinion.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or military experience
At least 5 years of experience in public affairs, issue advocacy campaign, earned media, political campaigns, or any combination of the four
At least 2 years of experience in a consulting or corporate setting, such as a PR agency or trade association

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working with elected officials, regulatory agencies, or political campaigns
Experience working in a highly regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or technology
Experience designing, planning and executing events
Experience developing presentations, leveraging AI responsibly and working efficiently under tight deadlines
Project management experience and a proven ability to help manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced environment while able to think quickly
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to manage internal and external relationships
Well-versed in current events and headline news at local, national, and international levels
Active personal network within the policy or financial services communities

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Richmond, VA: $122,100 - $139,400 for Communications Manager

McLean, VA: $134,400 - $153,300 for Communications Manager

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. Eligibility varies based on full or part-time status, exempt or non-exempt status, and management level.

This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

No agencies please. Capital One is an equal opportunity employer (EOE, including disability/vet) committed to non-discrimination in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Capital One promotes a drug-free workplace. Capital One will consider for employment qualified applicants with a criminal history in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable laws regarding criminal background inquiries, including, to the extent applicable, Article 23-A of the New York Correction Law; San Francisco, California Police Code Article 49, Sections 4901-4920; New York City’s Fair Chance Act; Philadelphia’s Fair Criminal Records Screening Act; and other applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations regarding criminal background inquiries.

If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1-800-304-9102 or via email at RecruitingAccommodation@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com

jobs.description:
This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.

She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.

The next step is to speak to Jack.

Job Title

Communications Lead

Salary

£80k-£90k + Equity

Company Description

Scarlet is a Creandum-backed London company of ~65 people, serving as Europe's only Notified Body specializing in AI and software medical device certification. They accelerate the path for cutting-edge medical technology to reach patients by removing regulatory delays for the world's most ambitious healthcare innovators.

Job Description

You will build Scarlet’s communications function from the ground up, owning content strategy, social media, and PR. By shaping the narrative around regulated AI medical devices, you’ll define the voice of a critical global industry. This hands-on role involves writing high-impact stories, managing LinkedIn presence, and securing press coverage to drive brand equity.

Location

London, UK

Why this role is remarkable

Join Europe's only specialized Notified Body for medical AI, sitting at the unique intersection of cutting-edge technology and global healthcare regulation.
Backed by Creandum with proven product-market fit and exponentially growing revenue, offering the stability of a successful firm with the autonomy of a startup.
Work directly with founders and world-leading experts, gaining unprecedented access to the most innovative companies in the medical technology sector.

What You Will Do

Create and edit world-class content, including customer success stories and technical blogs, to establish Scarlet as the definitive media voice in healthcare.
Lead Scarlet’s social media strategy, maintaining a high-quality daily cadence on LinkedIn to engage the industry and build brand authority.
Secure strategic press coverage and organize speaking opportunities at global conferences, elevating the profiles of Scarlet’s leadership team and technical experts.

The ideal candidate

Brings 5+ years of experience in communications, journalism, or content creation with a portfolio demonstrating extraordinary writing and editorial judgment.
Possesses a high EQ and an insatiable curiosity for complex technical topics, with the ability to make them feel human, urgent, and accessible.
Thrives in a hands-on environment, prioritizing the creation and execution of original PR initiatives over managing large teams or external agencies.

Who are Jack & Jill?

Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.

And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.

How does this work?

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

We never post fake jobs

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

This is a strategic role, responsible for leading the organisation's communications agenda across internal engagement, corporate communications, resident communications and reputation management. Part-Time | 9am-3pm | Hybrid

WWF-Singapore is part of the global WWF network, one of the world's largest and most respected independent conservation organisations. Our mission is to stop the degradation of the planet's natural environment and to build a future in which humans live in harmony with nature.
As Singapore strengthens its leadership in sustainability, WWF-Singapore plays an important role in advancing awareness, engagement and action on climate, nature and environmental issues through impactful communications and partnerships.

Overview

The Executive / Senior Executive, Strategic Communications supports the development and delivery of WWF-Singapore's integrated communications initiatives across digital, media and stakeholder engagement channels.

The role combines communications, media relations, content creation and visual storytelling to help translate complex sustainability topics into clear, engaging and impactful science-based content. The ideal candidate is a strong communicator with good design instincts, an eye for detail, an understanding of user experience principles, and a positive, proactive attitude.

Key Responsibilities

1. Communications & Media Relations

Develop and adapt content across digital, social media, website, publications and stakeholder communications channels.
Support communications campaigns, thought leadership initiatives and media engagement through the development of key messages, media materials and content assets.
Translate sustainability and conservation topics into clear, engaging and audience-centric communications while ensuring consistency with WWF's brand and messaging.
Develop a strong understanding of WWF-Singapore’s key competencies and advocacy positions on sustainability, climate change, conservation and related topics locally and internationally

2. Design & Digital Communications

Drive end-to-end content delivery across websites, digital platforms and exhibitions, coordinating with developers and vendors to ensure timely and effective implementation.
Curate and manage content across digital platforms, websites and exhibitions, and coordinate with developers, designers and external vendors to ensure accurate, engaging and timely implementation of content assets and visitor-facing experiences.
Apply design and UI/UX principles to strengthen visual storytelling, audience engagement and digital user experiences, including website content.
Stay abreast of emerging trends and best practices in communications, design and digital engagement.

3. Stakeholder Engagement & Project Coordination

Collaborate with internal teams, agencies and external partners to deliver integrated communications initiatives and organisational priorities.
Support events, media opportunities and stakeholder engagements, while coordinating vendors and communications-related projects.
Monitor communications performance, track engagement metrics and support reporting on outcomes and impact.

Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Multimedia, Design or a related field.
2 to 5 years of relevant experience in communications, public relations, media relations, content development or digital marketing.
Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to tailor content for different audiences and platforms.

Familiarity with website content management, digital publishing platforms, social media channels and data analysis tools.

Strong visual communication skills with a good eye for design, branding and user experience.

new_jobs.description:
At Capital One, we’re building a leading technology company. Founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One helps our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking. We measure our efforts by the success our customers enjoy and the advocacy they exhibit. We are succeeding because they are succeeding.

Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. We elevate each other and obsess about doing the right thing. Our associates serve with humility and a deep respect for their responsibility in helping our customers achieve their goals and realize their dreams. Together, we are on a quest to change banking for good.

Working for one of the world’s most recognized brands that is ranked #106 on the Fortune 500 and #15 on Fortune’s 100 Best Companies to Work For, Capital One provides multiple opportunities to learn and grow while engaging with world-class business leaders across the enterprise.

About the Role:

Capital One is looking for a strategic, creative and results-oriented communications professional to join our Public Affairs team within the Global Policy Affairs Group (GPAG.) Public Affairs is a cross-functional organization within Capital One’s Global Enterprise Affairs (GEA) team that leverages best practices across integrated marketing, strategic communications, stakeholder engagement, research and data intelligence, reputation management and issues advocacy to enable business growth and mitigate risk.

This is a high visibility role that will have direct and regular engagement with senior leaders both inside the company and within key partner organizations. This role provides the opportunity to drive high-visibility, multi-channel strategic communications strategies that tell the story of Capital One to decisionmaker audiences. It is also focused on engaging critical stakeholders and contributing to the national conversation around key economic and societal issues including credit access, affordable housing and entrepreneurship and business creation.

As a key member of the Public Affairs team, you will lead the development of comprehensive, multi-channel campaigns that educate, influence and tell the story of Capital One while advancing enterprise priorities. This role is designed for an experienced professional who can proactively identify emerging trends in the policy environment and macroeconomic landscape and translate complex issues into compelling, data-driven narratives. You will serve as a strategic advisor to internal business leaders and external stakeholders, including industry trade associations, nonprofit partners, think tanks, and policy and civic influencers. You will support the execution of a wide range of external events and convenings, earned media, influencer and digital advertising strategies – ensuring that our public affairs objectives are integrated into the broader corporate reputation and brand narrative.

This position requires exceptional judgment, creative problem solving, attention to detail, focus on results, and an innate ability to influence. A knack for distilling complex issues into compelling stories and a curiosity about perspectives different from your own are essential to the success of this role. Humility, adaptability and a sense of humor will also serve you well.

Primary Responsibilities:

Advocacy and Campaign Execution: Lead the end-to-end strategy and execution of integrated public affairs and data-driven campaigns (earned, paid, owned and digital) to advance policy, legislative and corporate reputation priorities at the federal, state and local levels.
Stakeholder and Third Party Management: Build and leverage trusted relationships with external stakeholders, including policy influencers, trade associations, think tanks, and non-profits to drive joint initiatives.
Media Relations: Cultivate deep relationships with beltway, national, regional and trade media outlets; pitch and secure targeted earned media moments to advance core enterprise narratives.
Executive and Strategic Counsel: Provide real-time, actionable strategic advice to senior business leaders and internal partners, ensuring communications seamlessly line up with enterprise objectives.
Messaging and Content Creation: Draft high-impact strategic materials, executive talking points, communications briefs, and positioning papers on complex issues.
Convenings and Events: Design, manage and execute high-impact thought leadership events, policymaker education programs and strategic convenings both inside and outside the beltway.
Data-Driven Narrative Development: Capitalize on proprietary research and data-driven insights to inform policymaker education, elevate executive profiles and shape public opinion.

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or military experience
At least 5 years of experience in public affairs, issue advocacy campaign, earned media, political campaigns, or any combination of the four
At least 2 years of experience in a consulting or corporate setting, such as a PR agency or trade association

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working with elected officials, regulatory agencies, or political campaigns
Experience working in a highly regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or technology
Experience designing, planning and executing events
Experience developing presentations, leveraging AI responsibly and working efficiently under tight deadlines
Project management experience and a proven ability to help manage multiple deliverables in a fast-paced environment while able to think quickly
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to manage internal and external relationships
Well-versed in current events and headline news at local, national, and international levels
Active personal network within the policy or financial services communities

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.

If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.

This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.

We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
